description.text: A big four-legged animal built like a rhinoceros, heavily muscled with thick legs and a brown carapace. Its large oval head bears two big horns or tusks, with rounded armour behind to guard the neck. Plates hang from its long tail, ending in a large triangular one, and its clawed feet seem to have opposable thumbs.

Terha carry riders, with saddle, bridle and saddlebags, on sandling hunts in the deep sand. They are rarer and more specialised than tonks; Kenton never rode one before hunting with Lord Raagent. Those bred for hunting are treated from birth with a substance called DoKall so their carapace will not dissolve when wet. Raagent praises their toughness, and they spook less easily than tonks.
Like tonks and some sandlings, they have horns and carapace that water can dissolve.
